description:
Fetch JSON-LD import/export profiles available for a project (id and label each).
Pass configTypeId to read that one profile's field mapping instead: every JSON-LD key it knows and what the key imports as - importAs is mixin (target = mixin column id), relation (target = relation group id), newMixin/newRelation (created on import), space, or none (ignored). targetLabel names the mixin column or relation group; isReversed marks a relation read in the opposite direction.

configTypeId.description: Optional. A profile id from this tool's list; returns that profile's field mapping.

name: fetch_json_ld_import_profiles
title: Fetch JSON-LD Import Profiles
